jobs.occupation: Bus Mechanic – good salary + training opportunies
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working on vehicles and solving technical problems? In this role as a bus mechanic, you ensure that coaches are safe, reliable and ready for daily operations.

• You carry out maintenance and repairs on buses.

• You diagnose mechanical issues and fix them efficiently.

• You perform preventive maintenance to keep vehicles in top condition.

• You work on a varied fleet of different brands and models.

• You ensure every vehicle meets safety and quality standards.

• You have a background in mechanics (experience is a strong plus).

• You can work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.

• You are able to identify and solve technical problems.

• You are eager to learn and interested in new vehicle technologies (like electricity).

• You are open to following additional training.

• You speak Dutch or English.

• You are flexible with working hours while valuing a good work-life balance.

• A driving license D is a plus.

For a company in the Tielt region, active in the food industry, we are looking for a motivated and reliable Packaging Operator.

Your responsibilities:

• Operating and monitoring packaging machines and equipment.

• Preparing products for the packaging process.

• You like working with vegetables

• Checking the quality of packaged products.

• Monitoring the packaging and production process.

• Solving minor machine issues and reporting technical problems to the supervisor.

• Keeping the workplace clean and organized.

• Following all safety, hygiene, and quality procedures.

 

 

Your profile:

• Experience in production or machine operation is an advantage.

• Willingness to work during the day

• Reliable, accurate and motivated.

• Able to work independently as well as part of a team.

• Good work ethic and a responsible attitude.

• Besides Polish or Romanian of other language,  you also  have a good knowledge of English

jobs.occupation: Sr. Accountant position w/ strategic impact - Zaventem - Legal
jobs.description:
Our client is an international firm that provides legal services across different sectors. They are currently looking for a senior accountant that can work autonomously to support the finance manager.

Jobomschrijving

In this role you will be handling the A-Z accounting tasks, including the following:

• General accounting tasks
• Performing monthly, quarterly, and year-end closings
• Review and control of the balance sheet
• Preparation and filing of the annual accounts (NBB)
• Submission of periodic VAT returns
• Preparation of corporate income tax
• Point of contact for audit matters
• Monthly financial reporting
• Process optimization and automation

We are looking for someone that matches the following criteria:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting
• Minimum of 5 years experience in general accounting
• Strong knowledge of BE GAAP
• Fluent in Dutch and/or French, good command in English
• Excellent command of Excel
• Analytical mindset
• Team player with good communication skills

Are you a skilled welder with an eye for detail and a passion for metalworking? Then we have a great opportunity for you!

Jobomschrijving

As a welder, you will be responsible for accurately assembling and welding a variety of metal constructions based on technical drawings and specifications. You play an important role in delivering high-quality end products and actively contribute to maintaining craftsmanship and reliability. You will work closely with your colleagues to ensure projects are completed efficiently and within set deadlines. In addition, you act as a representative of the organization in contacts with clients and partners.

·        Experience in welding, preferably semi-automatic (TIG is a strong plus)·        Accuracy and a strong focus on quality·        Flexibility and the ability to work under pressure·        Team spirit and a positive work attitude·        A professional and presentable appearance·        Proficiency in Dutch or English·        Willingness to learn and further develop your skills

For a family-run metal workshop specializing in the production of steel doors and windows, we are looking for a semi-automatic welder to join the team. The company is known for its high-quality finishes, attention to detail, and passion for interior design and architecture. Every project is tailor-made — from design to the finished product — with a strong focus on craftsmanship and precision.

Job description:
As a semi-automatic welder, you will help produce steel doors and windows for both interior and exterior applications. You will be responsible for very fine welding work and ensure that every piece meets the highest quality standards.

Your tasks:

• 
Performing fine welding work (semi-automatic)

• 
Filing, grinding, and assembling components

• 
Cleaning and smoothing weld seams

• 
Reading and interpreting technical drawings

• 
Delivering precise, high-quality work

Profile:

• 
You have experience as a welder or are a motivated school leaver

• 
You can read and understand technical plans

• 
You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English

• 
You enjoy detailed, varied work during day shifts

jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.
 

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!
 

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.
 

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety. 
 

 

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m.
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.

You will help produce high-quality safety boots used in industries such as agriculture, food production, construction, and fishing.

• Assemble components onto moulds before production
• Operate production machines together with a colleague

• Trim and finish products by removing excess material
• Carry out detailed quality inspections
• Ensure every product meets the required quality standards

Your Profile

• Experience in a production environment is an advantage
• You are willing to learn and develop new skills
• You work accurately and have a strong eye for detail
• Quality is your top priority
• You enjoy working closely with colleagues and supporting the team
• You have your own transportation
• You speak English or Dutch and English (you are able to follow training and work instructions in English)Working Environment
• Modern manufacturing environment
• Standing work throughout most of the shift
• Team-oriented workplace with colleagues from different nationalities (Polish, Ukrainian, Hungarian etc)
